label: Referral or prior authorization required
kff_category: Lack of prior authorization or referral
cms_definition: Non-emergency claims for services that required prior authorization, referral, prior approval or precertification and were denied.
note: A tally of denial reasons over the life of claims, not a count of unique claims; the ten tallies are not asserted to sum to denied claims.

label: Out-of-network provider
cms_definition: Claims denied for services from outside the plan network when the plan has a closed network.
note: A tally of denial reasons over the life of claims, not a count of unique claims; the ten tallies are not asserted to sum to denied claims.

label: Service excluded
cms_definition: Claims denied for limits or exclusions of services, supplies and so on, including drugs not on the formulary.
note: A tally of denial reasons over the life of claims, not a count of unique claims; the ten tallies are not asserted to sum to denied claims.

label: Medical necessity, excluding behavioral health
kff_category: Not medically necessary, excluding behavioral health
cms_definition: In-network claims denied for services not meeting accepted standards to diagnose or treat, medical services.
note: A tally of denial reasons over the life of claims, not a count of unique claims; the ten tallies are not asserted to sum to denied claims.

label: Medical necessity, behavioral health only
cms_definition: As above, related to behavioral or mental health.
note: A tally of denial reasons over the life of claims, not a count of unique claims; the ten tallies are not asserted to sum to denied claims.

label: Enrollee benefit limit reached
cms_definition: In-network claims denied because the beneficiary reached an annual benefit limit.
note: A tally of denial reasons over the life of claims, not a count of unique claims; the ten tallies are not asserted to sum to denied claims.

label: Member not covered
cms_definition: In-network claims denied because of the beneficiary's enrollment status when services were rendered.
note: A tally of denial reasons over the life of claims, not a count of unique claims; the ten tallies are not asserted to sum to denied claims.

label: Investigational, experimental or cosmetic
cms_definition: In-network claims denied because the procedure was investigational, cosmetic or experimental.
note: A tally of denial reasons over the life of claims, not a count of unique claims; the ten tallies are not asserted to sum to denied claims.

label: Administrative reason
cms_definition: In-network claims denied for administrative reasons such as duplicate claim, missing information, untimely filing, billing provider not approved, coordination of benefits, inconsistent codes, workers compensation, paid by other insurance, unable to identify patient.
note: A tally of denial reasons over the life of claims, not a count of unique claims; the ten tallies are not asserted to sum to denied claims.

label: Other reason not listed
cms_definition: In-network claims denied for any reason not enumerated in another category.
note: A tally of denial reasons over the life of claims, not a count of unique claims; the ten tallies are not asserted to sum to denied claims.
